findings.message: This image might run with "root" as the default user. Make sure it is safe here.
findings.actual_security_impact: Container UID 0 is required for package installation in a lab builder. The recorded builds use rootless Podman, no host network or system installation, read-only producer input and scratch-only write mounts. It is not a deployed service.
findings.fix_or_rationale: Retain builder root. Invocations must remain rootless and network-disabled for builds. Do not run this image as a privileged host service.

findings.message: Path Traversal via faulty LLM-supplied CLI arguments in bundle.main()
findings.actual_security_impact: CLI paths are explicitly operator-selected; captured fields never determine a filesystem path. There is no remote path-traversal boundary. The previous write_text could nevertheless overwrite an existing file or follow an output symlink, losing evidence.
findings.fix_or_rationale: Use exclusive output creation, refuse existing files and symlinks, and test preservation on accepted and refused input. Manifest reads are intentionally selected by the operator; no artificial cwd confinement.
